findings.summary: Duplicate customer_id rows in segments cause the merge to duplicate orders, so amount_cents is summed multiple times and per-segment revenue is overstated.

judge.reason: Describes merge on customer_id duplicating orders due to multiple segment rows per customer, overstating revenue.

findings.label: hit

findings.summary: how="inner" in the merge silently drops orders from customers missing in segments, and groupby drops null segments by default, so segment totals don't add up to total revenue.

judge.reason: Matches the known inner-join and NaN-groupby problems, not the duplication bug.

findings.label: valid_other
